title: A multimodal whole-slide foundation model for pathology
study_context: Mass-340K pretraining combines institutional/consult pathology slides and GTEx, with H&E, IHC and special stains; clinical slide-level downstream benchmarks include renal allograft rejection.
population_or_data: Mass-340K pretraining combines institutional/consult pathology slides and GTEx, with H&E, IHC and special stains; clinical slide-level downstream benchmarks include renal allograft rejection.
task: Mass-340K pretraining combines institutional/consult pathology slides and GTEx, with H&E, IHC and special stains; clinical slide-level downstream benchmarks include renal allograft rejection.
method: CONCHv1.5 patch features and spatial slide encoder, followed by vision-language alignment. Frozen slide embeddings evaluated with logistic regression, prototypes and other heads.
main_findings: TITAN pretraining includes GTEx alongside clinical pathology and multiple stains, uses CONCHv1.5 patch features, and evaluates fixed slide embeddings with logistic regression and few-shot class prototypes against mean-pooling and ABMIL baselines.

TITAN includes renal allograft rejection (4847 H&E WSIs from 1118 patients). Its renal dataset paragraph describes label-stratified slide counts, while its survival protocol selects a penalty using the best average test metric across folds.
limitations: Selected-page methods/results/limitations review; text and rendered PDF pages 1, 14, 16, 17, 19 checked on 2026-10-07. Not a complete paper/supplement audit.
Published article, November 2025; Tong Ding first author. Stable candidate ID chen2025_titan retained for retrieval compatibility.

Does not isolate the contribution of GTEx/autopsy material or demonstrate heart rejection benefit. It is not a drop-in pooling layer for current UNI v2 features; patch encoder, physical scale and coordinates must match.

The renal paragraph alone does not demonstrate patient-disjoint partitions. Renal AMR/cellular rejection is not cardiac ACR/AMR. Survival penalty selection raises model-selection optimism concerns for that analysis, not every TITAN task; no quantitative superiority or independent survival validation claim is indexed.

relevance_to_project: Supports a pretrained slide-representation comparator and an additional mixed clinical/GTEx pretraining precedent relevant to autopsy transfer planning. Provides a noncardiac transplant representation benchmark and concrete validation details to audit before transferring a protocol.
